comparison.objective: Place caplets in two designated organizer cells and snap every lid shut; candidate separates media from retained workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-object placement plus fingernail-scale snap-lid opening/closing while stabilizing a light strip versus load-shared screen agitation and particle-size separation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct one-caplet-per-day occupancy, no wrong-day insertion, all lids snapped and released stillness versus recovery fraction, washer retention, screen support and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: Although both manage multiple loose objects, the tested abilities and terminal states—discrete dosing with latching versus physical sieving with selective retention—are meaningfully different; rubric details are complete enough.
